body: 2026-10-03, 01:15 to 02:15: lab checks, Note 10+ tests and manual-test installs, all at main 9e41b3ba.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Full suite on merged main.**U+000AU+002D Analyze is clean and every folder passes.U+000AU+002D One test in test/tooling (android_dump_rules_test, 'the command prints sorted IDs...') failed on the first run in a fresh worktree, with the `dart run` subprocess printing nothing. It passed alone and in a full rerun of the folder (106 of 106). It is a first-run flake, not a merge problem.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Leftover cleanup** (owner-approved).U+000AU+002D Removed 17 worktrees of merged runs: meadow-recolour*, onboarding-v7*, v7-* run trees, and testkit/work main-e36ea84, onboarding-v7, pacer, pacing-probe, recolour-247 and recolour-amend.U+000AU+002D Deleted their 13 local branches. This freed 28 GB.U+000AU+002D Two worktrees had uncommitted changes. The pacing-probe diff matches testkit/patches/pacing-probe.patch. The onboarding-v7 build-id diff was saved as testkit/patches/v7-build-0180934.patch.U+000AU+002D testkit/work/manual and postmerge were kept.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Device-pass kit:** ~/.mitosis/field-notes/prototype-phone-macos/device-pass/.U+000AU+002D Build scripts: build_android.zsh and build_mac.zsh, which apply plain-build-8aa7fd0.patch and swap the app id per target. The *_scratch variants copy in scratch/shell_glass_bench_test.dart.U+000AU+002D run_apk_test.zsh: separate app id, unlock check, logcat result, uninstall, and other installs unchanged.U+000AU+002D install_seeded.zsh: SERIAL-generic; refuses if .plain is already installed.U+000AU+002D phone_all.zsh: waits for unlock.U+000AU+002D mac_run.zsh: lab VM.U+000AU+002D shell_parse.py.U+000AU+002D seeds/: journal.sql copies days and entries from a snapshot of the Mac .plain container; october.sql; onboarded.sql.U+000AU+002D Results are in results/.U+000AU+002D Builds:U+000A  U+002D Android profile APKs: plain, fresh, mbench, sbench, nbench and itest-*.U+000A  U+002D macOS: release plain and fresh; profile meadow_bench, shell_bench and itest_*.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Scratch shell bench** (not committed). It mounts the full FieldNotesApp on an IntegrationSandbox seeded with days from 2025-01-01, measures 10 s per case and prints NOTE-PERF-BENCH shell.* lines.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Note 10+ results** (Impeller OpenGL ES; Vulkan was tried and fell back). Two shell runs and three Meadow runs, each consistent.U+000AU+002D Shell, bottom bar:U+000AU+000A  | Case | fps | Raster p50 / p90 |U+000A  |---|---|---|U+000A  | Today, no mood | 60 | 9.4 / 11.1 ms |U+000A  | Today, peony | 60 | 11.2 / 12.8 ms |U+000A  | Today, lavender | 60 | 12.9 / 14.5 ms |U+000A  | Calendar, lavender | 60 | 13.4 / 15.3 ms |U+000A  | Meadow in the shell (header, dock and tab bar glass) | 42 | 24.2 / 25.0 ms |U+000A  | Meadow with the time pop-over | 35 | 28.8 / 29.5 ms |U+000AU+000AU+002D The lavender draw cost is about +1.7 ms over peony and holds 60 fps.U+000AU+002D Meadow bench (GardenScreen alone):U+000A  U+002D Full screen, and the sidebar geometry at phone size: 60 fps.U+000A  U+002D Phone layout: page 60 at noon and 54 at midnight; study 53 and 46; pop-over 50 and 43, with longest frames of 100 to 145 ms.U+000A  U+002D Scene ready in 0.7 to 1.0 s.U+000A  U+002D Before the prototype work (8aa7fd0, 2026-09-30), 12 of 12 cases held 60 fps.U+000AU+002D Battery temperature rose from 26.1 to 33.6 C over the runs.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Integration tests** (never run by CI or the suite).U+000AU+002D capture_save_persist, media_playback_format and sandbox_containment pass on the emulator, the Note 10+ and the macOS VM.U+000AU+002D capture_ui_flow fails:U+000A  U+002D Android, 4 of 4: it taps the desktop capture rows on Today, but the phone layout puts them behind +.U+000A  U+002D macOS, 3 of 4: 'Saving…' is never shown, and the voice and video sheets stay open after a 'Voice playback load failed (-11829)' on the fake file.U+000A  U+002D The macOS failures also happen at 8aa7fd08, so they predate this work.U+000A  U+002D Spun off as task chip task_e64705b0.U+000AU+002D note_perf_bench hung on its first case on the phone (focused editor and keyboard) and was stopped after about 100 s. It is unrelated to this work.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Lab Android emulator** (Pixel 9). The golden has animator_duration_scale 0, which stops the petals and motion; animations were turned on inside the instance.U+000AU+002D The phone shell is phone-native.U+000AU+002D The mood sheet works, and lavender sprigs drift.U+000AU+002D The flower month calendar and Search with the bottom field are right.U+000AU+002D Settings matches the Lane 10 render, gap included.U+000AU+002D The rose launcher icon matches the source SVG.U+000AU+002D The reminder fired at the scheduled minute, and the status bar shows the white peony silhouette.U+000AU+002D Onboarding works end to end: plant, swipe, Mood with the soil to the bottom edge and the stake, the lavender regrow, the note gate, other ways, the month slider, the year, the theme, the reminder permission, the week start and the tour.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Findings.**U+000A1U+002E Status bar icons stay dark over the phone Meadow's dark glass header. They are near-invisible at night and low-contrast in the afternoon. The cause: app.dart's AnnotatedRegion follows the theme brightness only, and BottomBarShell's overScene never overrides it.U+000A2U+002E A fresh macOS install opens at about 873x632 (minimum content height 600, MainFlutterWindow.swift:18). There, on the onboarding Mood step, the peony overlaps 'grows' and the lavender covers the subtitle and the 'a day' label. At 1140x780 it clears.U+000A3U+002E The blocked-swipe toast on the phone note step is see-through glass, and the 'write anything at all to keep going' hint shows through its text.U+000A4U+002E The phone Meadow frame rate on the Note 10+, as above (cost reported per the owner's decision).U+000AU+000AU+002A*macOS VM checks.**U+000AU+002D The Dock icon is the rose on Apple's grid.U+000AU+002D The seeded sidebar app is right: Today with this week's garden and on this day, and Meadow with the glass study dock.U+000AU+002D VM frame times are noisy: a Calendar run of 28 fps did not repeat (61 fps the second time). They are not used as evidence.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Installs.**U+000AU+002D Note 10+: dev.satanshumishra.field_notes.fresh, and .plain seeded with 2024-01-01 to 2026-10-02 (1,006 days, 643 notes, onboarding done, today empty). The app was confirmed open on Today.U+000AU+002D Mac:U+000A  U+002D ~/Applications/field_notes_plain.app and field_notes_fresh.app.U+000A  U+002D The existing .plain container journal was backed up as field_notes.sqlite.bak-2026-10-03, then extended with october.sql.U+000A  U+002D .fresh has no container.U+000AU+002D The phone had no Field Notes app when testing began. The owner removed dev.satanshumishra.field_notes.v7 through the Samsung launcher's uninstall dialog at 01:36:46 (events log), before any command from this session.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Checklist:** docs/specs/prototype-phone-macos-changes.device-checklist.md (git-ignored).U+000AU+000AU+002A*Housekeeping noted:** main's onboarding_controller.g.dart has a stale Riverpod debug hash; build_runner changes only that line.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Lab:** `lab down --all` left nothing behind. The three build and check worktrees were removed.
